What Kills People? Death Shares by Country

Source: vignettes/death_shares_shinylive.qmd 
#| '!! shinylive warning !!': |
#|   shinylive does not work in self-contained HTML documents.
#|   Please set `embed-resources: false` in your metadata.
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 900

library(shiny)
library(bslib)

ds <- read.csv("death_shares.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
countries <- sort(unique(ds$country))

# Colour palette: ColorBrewer Set2 (8 colours, colourblind safe)
# NCD causes get warm tones, infectious get cool tones
NCD_COLOURS <- c(
  "Cardiovascular diseases" = "#e41a1c",
  "Neoplasms"               = "#ff7f00",
  "Chronic respiratory diseases" = "#fdbf6f",
  "Diabetes mellitus"       = "#a6cee3",
  "Digestive diseases"      = "#cab2d6",
  "Chronic liver disease"   = "#fb9a99",
  "Chronic kidney disease"  = "#b2df8a"
)
INF_COLOURS <- c(
  "Lower respiratory infections" = "#1f78b4",
  "Diarrheal diseases"           = "#33a02c",
  "Tuberculosis"                 = "#6a3d9a",
  "HIV/AIDS"                     = "#b15928",
  "Malaria"                      = "#ffff99",
  "Hepatitis"                    = "#a6d854",
  "Meningitis"                   = "#66c2a5"
)
ALL_COLOURS <- c(NCD_COLOURS, INF_COLOURS)

make_treemap_html <- function(data, chart_id) {
  if (nrow(data) == 0) return("<p style='color:#888;text-align:center'>No data</p>")

  # Sort by share descending
  data <- data[order(-data$share_pct), ]

  total_rate <- sum(data$deaths_per_100k)
  country_name <- data$country[1]

  # Build HTML treemap (pure CSS grid, no plotly needed)
  cells <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(data)), function(i) {
    cause <- data$cause[i]
    pct <- data$share_pct[i]
    rate <- data$deaths_per_100k[i]
    cat_label <- data$category[i]
    col <- if (cause %in% names(ALL_COLOURS)) ALL_COLOURS[cause] else "#666"

    # Calculate font size based on share
    fsize <- max(0.7, min(1.4, 0.7 + pct / 40))

    # Calculate cell flex basis (minimum 8% for readability)
    basis <- max(8, pct)

    sprintf(
      paste0('<div class="tm-cell" style="flex-basis:%s%%;background:%s;" ',
             'title="%s\n%s\n%.1f deaths/100k (%.1f%%)">\n',
             '<div class="tm-label" style="font-size:%.2frem">%s</div>\n',
             '<div class="tm-val">%.1f%%</div>\n',
             '<div class="tm-rate">%.1f/100k</div>\n',
             '</div>'),
      round(basis, 1), col,
      cause, cat_label, rate, pct,
      fsize, cause,
      pct, rate
    )
  }, character(1))

  header <- sprintf(
    paste0('<div class="tm-header">%s &mdash; %d causes, ',
           '%.0f deaths/100k (14 tracked causes)</div>'),
    country_name, nrow(data), total_rate
  )

  paste0(
    '<div id="', chart_id, '" class="tm-container">\n',
    header, '\n',
    '<div class="tm-grid">\n',
    paste(cells, collapse = "\n"),
    '\n</div>\n</div>'
  )
}

make_summary_table <- function(data) {
  if (nrow(data) == 0) return(NULL)
  data <- data[order(-data$share_pct), ]
  data$rank <- seq_len(nrow(data))
  data[, c("rank", "category", "cause", "deaths_per_100k", "share_pct")]
}

pcss <- "
body { background: #0d0d1a; color: #e0e0e0; }
.tm-container { margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
.tm-header {
  font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff;
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem; background: #16213e;
  border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0; border-bottom: 2px solid #4a90d9;
}
.tm-grid {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 3px;
  padding: 6px; background: #1a1a2e; border-radius: 0 0 8px 8px;
}
.tm-cell {
  flex-grow: 1; min-height: 80px; min-width: 60px;
  border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px; cursor: default;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center;
  align-items: center; text-align: center;
  transition: transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s;
}
.tm-cell:hover {
  transform: scale(1.03); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(74,144,217,0.5);
  z-index: 10;
}
.tm-label { font-weight: 600; color: #fff; text-shadow: 1px 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.7); line-height: 1.2; }
.tm-val { font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-top: 4px; }
.tm-rate { font-size: 0.75rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); }
.card { background: #1a1a2e; border: 1px solid #2a2a4e; border-radius: 8px; padding: 1rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
.ctrl-row { display: flex; gap: 1rem; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
.ctrl-row label { color: #aaa; font-weight: 600; }
.ctrl-row select {
  background: #16213e; color: #e0e0e0; border: 1px solid #444;
  border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 1rem; min-width: 200px;
}
.legend-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; margin: 0.75rem 0; padding: 0.5rem; background: #16213e; border-radius: 6px; }
.legend-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-size: 0.8rem; }
.legend-swatch { width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 3px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.compare-toggle { background: #2a2a4e; color: #ccc; border: 1px solid #444; border-radius: 16px; padding: 6px 16px; cursor: pointer; }
.compare-toggle:hover { background: #3a3a5e; }
.compare-toggle.active { background: #4a90d9; color: #fff; border-color: #4a90d9; }
.tbl-wrap { margin-top: 1rem; overflow-x: auto; }
.tbl-wrap table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.9rem; }
.tbl-wrap th { background: #16213e; color: #aaa; padding: 8px 12px; text-align: left; border-bottom: 2px solid #444; }
.tbl-wrap td { padding: 6px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a4e; }
.tbl-wrap tr:hover { background: #1e1e3a; }
.note { color: #888; font-size: 0.85rem; font-style: italic; margin-top: 1rem; padding: 0.75rem; background: #16213e; border-radius: 6px; }
"

ui <- page_fluid(
  tags$style(HTML(pcss)),

  div(class = "card",
    h2("What Kills People?", style = "color:#fff;margin:0 0 0.25rem 0"),
    p("Proportional causes of death by country (14 tracked causes, GBD 2019).",
      style = "color:#aaa;margin:0 0 1rem 0"),

    div(class = "ctrl-row",
      tags$label("Country:"),
      selectInput("country1", NULL,
        choices = countries,
        selected = if ("Ireland" %in% countries) "Ireland" else countries[1],
        width = "220px"),
      actionButton("toggle_compare", "Compare two countries",
        class = "compare-toggle")
    ),

    conditionalPanel(
      condition = "input.toggle_compare % 2 == 1",
      div(class = "ctrl-row",
        tags$label("Compare with:"),
        selectInput("country2", NULL,
          choices = countries,
          selected = if ("Nigeria" %in% countries) "Nigeria" else countries[2],
          width = "220px")
      )
    ),

    # Legend
    uiOutput("legend_ui")
  ),

  # Treemaps
  div(class = "card",
    uiOutput("treemap1")
  ),

  conditionalPanel(
    condition = "input.toggle_compare % 2 == 1",
    div(class = "card",
      uiOutput("treemap2")
    )
  ),

  # Summary table
  div(class = "card",
    h3("Detail", style = "color:#fff;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0"),
    uiOutput("summary_table")
  ),

  div(class = "note",
    HTML(paste0(
      "Data: IHME Global Burden of Disease 2019 via Our World in Data. ",
      "Shows 14 causes (7 non-communicable + 7 infectious). ",
      "Shares are relative to these 14 causes only &mdash; injuries, maternal, ",
      "and neonatal causes are not yet included (see ",
      "<a href='https://github.com/JohnGavin/micromort/issues/91' ",
      "style='color:#4a90d9'>issue #91</a>). ",
      "Age-standardised death rates per 100,000 population."
    ))
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # Toggle compare button styling
  observeEvent(input$toggle_compare, {
    is_on <- input$toggle_compare %% 2 == 1
    if (is_on) {
      runjs("document.getElementById('toggle_compare').classList.add('active')")
    } else {
      runjs("document.getElementById('toggle_compare').classList.remove('active')")
    }
  })

  data1 <- reactive({
    ds[ds$country == input$country1, ]
  })

  data2 <- reactive({
    req(input$toggle_compare %% 2 == 1)
    ds[ds$country == input$country2, ]
  })

  output$legend_ui <- renderUI({
    all_causes <- unique(ds$cause)
    items <- lapply(all_causes, function(cause) {
      col <- if (cause %in% names(ALL_COLOURS)) ALL_COLOURS[cause] else "#666"
      div(class = "legend-item",
        div(class = "legend-swatch", style = paste0("background:", col)),
        cause
      )
    })
    div(class = "legend-row", items)
  })

  output$treemap1 <- renderUI({
    HTML(make_treemap_html(data1(), "tm1"))
  })

  output$treemap2 <- renderUI({
    HTML(make_treemap_html(data2(), "tm2"))
  })

  output$summary_table <- renderUI({
    d1 <- make_summary_table(data1())
    comparing <- input$toggle_compare %% 2 == 1

    make_rows <- function(df, label) {
      rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
        col <- if (df$cause[i] %in% names(ALL_COLOURS)) ALL_COLOURS[df$cause[i]] else "#666"
        tags$tr(
          tags$td(df$rank[i]),
          tags$td(div(class = "legend-swatch",
            style = paste0("background:", col, ";display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:6px")),
            df$cause[i]),
          tags$td(df$category[i]),
          tags$td(style = "text-align:right", sprintf("%.1f", df$deaths_per_100k[i])),
          tags$td(style = "text-align:right;font-weight:600", sprintf("%.1f%%", df$share_pct[i]))
        )
      })
      if (!is.null(label)) {
        rows <- c(
          list(tags$tr(tags$td(colspan = "5",
            style = "background:#0d0d1a;color:#4a90d9;font-weight:700;padding:10px",
            label))),
          rows
        )
      }
      rows
    }

    header <- tags$thead(tags$tr(
      tags$th("#"), tags$th("Cause"), tags$th("Category"),
      tags$th(style = "text-align:right", "Deaths/100k"),
      tags$th(style = "text-align:right", "Share")
    ))

    if (comparing) {
      d2 <- make_summary_table(data2())
      rows <- c(
        make_rows(d1, input$country1),
        make_rows(d2, input$country2)
      )
    } else {
      rows <- make_rows(d1, NULL)
    }

    div(class = "tbl-wrap",
      tags$table(header, tags$tbody(rows))
    )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
